1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
    10	#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
    11	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
    12	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
    13	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
    14	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
    15	#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
    16	#
    17	# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
    18	# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
    19	#
    20	# Writes (seed):
    21	#   <corpus>/pr-NN/{fixture.yaml, head.diff, PR.md, REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,
    22	#                   AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, base/…, head/…}     (copied into the sandbox)
    23	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.tsv          HIDDEN (never copied into a sandbox): the labels,
    24	#                                      first line `# approved-by: pending`
    25	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt  HIDDEN: every finding that did not become a label, and why
    26	#   <corpus>/manifests/pr-NN.json      HIDDEN: the graded manifest (`approved: false` until --approve)
    27	#   <corpus>/corpus.tsv                one `record` row per fixture (or a `#` gap comment)
    28	#   evals/tasks/{review,audit}-recall/{review,audit}-pr-NN.yaml
    29	#   <corpus>/SHA256SUMS                refreshed
    30	#
    31	# Scope: the fixture is the change base..head without the generated or state
    32	# files (grimoires/, CHANGELOG.md, .claude/checksums.json, REPO-MAP.md, lock

   427	        if RX_H.match(l) and not RX_B.match(l):

# Skill Frontmatter Invariants

SKILL.md frontmatter keys interact across two permission layers: the skill's own `capabilities` / `allowed-tools` declarations, and Claude Code's per-agent-type tool allowlist. When the two disagree, the agent-type allowlist wins — silently. Agents that declare write capability but dispatch through a read-only agent type produce correct output and then refuse to persist it.

## The invariant

When a skill declares write capability — either `capabilities.write_files: true` OR `allowed-tools` listing `Write`/`Edit` — it MUST NOT set `agent:` to a type that excludes those tools.

Allowed: omit the `agent:` key (skill runs in the caller's context), or set `agent:` to a write-capable type (`general-purpose`, `claude`, `fork`).

# Git Stash Safety

`git stash push / pop` wraps are risky inside Loa skill execution: pre-commit hooks run their own internal `git stash --keep-index`, an overlapping outer stash shifts the indexes, and `pop` can land on the wrong entry. Combined with output-swallowing (`| tail -N`, `|| true`, `2>/dev/null`) this produces silent data loss that looks like success.

**Mechanically enforced since cycle-122**: `block-destructive-bash.sh` pattern `FR-1.2b` BLOCKS `git stash push/pop/apply` combined with `| tail`/`| head`, `|| true`, or `2>/dev/null` in the same statement — the block message is the repair prompt. #               (or the same wrapped in hook-guard.sh); one row per unique script
#   fences      the `# @guard fence:<id>` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh,
#               cross-checked both ways against its emit_block call sites and
#               its literal `pattern_id: "<id>"` audit constants
#   validators  the `# @guard validator:<id>` markers in validate-artifact.sh
#   gates       the fixed list in the origin map (each row's `script` must exist)
#   policies    the floor policies in the origin map
# Origins, class, status, knob and floor come from .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml;
# the floor set must equal .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards.
#
# Outputs:
#   grimoires/loa/guards.md        tracked, STRUCTURAL ONLY (a pure function of the
#                                  repository; no timestamp, no yield) — --check gates it
#   .run/guard-yield.md, .json     untracked host yield: blocks_30d, likely_fp_30d,
#                                  telemetry_30d, last_real_catch per guard
#   hooks-reference.md table       with --hooks-table, the rows between
#                                  <!-- guard-register:begin --> and <!-- guard-register:end -->
#
# Yield (SDD D-1.3): rows of .run/audit.jsonl and its rotated segments
# .run/audit.jsonl.* with action == "block", plus implement-gate rows (telemetry
# when action is telemetry or ask), with ts inside the window. Replays are

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
    56	DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
    57	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
    58	# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
    59	# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
    60	SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
    61	
    62	SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
    63	CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
    64	DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
    65	
    66	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    67	die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    68	
    69	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    70	  case "$1" in
    71	    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
    82	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    83	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    84	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
    89	case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
    90	[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
    91	[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
    92	[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
    93	[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
    94	[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
    95	for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    96	
    97	SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
    98	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    99	TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
   100	
   101	IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
   102	IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
   103	[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
   104	[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
   105	for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
   106	  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
   107	  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
   108	    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
   109	done
   110	for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   111	  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
   112	  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
   113	  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
   114	  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
   115	  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
   116	        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
   117	    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
   118	  fi
   119	done
   120	
   121	SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
   122	  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
   123	SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
   124	WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
   125	
   126	[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
   127	[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
   128	SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
   129	BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
   130	
   131	# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}

   251	if [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" ]] && [[ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")" == "false" ]]; then

   258	LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
   259	log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; }

   261	STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
   262	STATE="running"
   263	# per-arm counters (indexed arrays parallel to ARMS — bash 3.2 has no maps)
   264	DONE=() FAILED=() PLANNED=()
   265	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do DONE[$i]=0; FAILED[$i]=0; PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${#FIXTURES[@]} * TRIALS )); done
   266	arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
   267	
   268	write_status() {
   269	  local per='{}' i finished=null
   270	  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
   271	    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson d "${DONE[$i]}" --argjson f "${FAILED[$i]}" --argjson p "${PLANNED[$i]}" \
   272	      '. + {($a): {trials_done: $d, trials_failed: $f, trials_planned: $p}}' <<<"$per")"
   273	  done
   274	  [[ "$STATE" != "running" ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
   275	  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
   276	    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
   277	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
   278	      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
   279	  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
   280	  aggregate_status
   281	}
   282	
   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
   287	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
   288	  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
   289	  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
   290	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
   291	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   293	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   295	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   296	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   297	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   298	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   299	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   300	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \

   305	set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
   306	
   307	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
   308	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
   309	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
   310	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
   311	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
   312	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
   313	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0

   315	    "$err" "$out" 2>/dev/null && return 0

   317	}
   318	
   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
   320	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
   321	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
   322	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
   323	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
   324	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
   325	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   326	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   327	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
   328	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   329	  fi
   330	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   331	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   332	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   333	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   334	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   335	    ex_rc=0
   336	    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   337	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   338	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   339	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   340	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   341	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   342	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   343	      local gout gexit=0
   344	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   345	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
   346	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
   347	        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
   348	      fi
   349	      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
   350	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
   351	      break
   352	    fi
   353	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
   354	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"

   361	    else
   362	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"

   365	  done
   366	  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"

   368	    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""

   371	  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
   372	    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
   374	    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
   375	    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
   376	    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
   377	    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
   378	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}

   383	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
   384	}
   385	
   386	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
   387	  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
   388	  mkdir -p "$dest"

   391	  done
   392	  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
   393	  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)

   395	  return 0
   396	}
   397	
   398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
   399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
   400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
   401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
   403	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
   404	    set_state failed; exit 3
   405	  fi
   406	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
   407	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
   408	    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
   409	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
   410	      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
   411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   412	    else
   413	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   414	      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   415	    fi
   416	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
   417	  else
   418	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   419	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
   420	  fi
   421	  write_status
   422	}
   423	
   424	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
   425	write_status
   426	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done
   454	reap 1
   455	
   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
   459	  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
   464	fi

# --- PHASE: LOAD_SUITE ---
load_tasks() {
  TASK_FILES=()

  if [[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]]; then
    # Single task mode
    local task_file
    task_file="$(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name "${TASK_ID}.yaml" -o -name "${TASK_ID}.yml" | head -1)"
    if [[ -z "$task_file" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Task not found: $TASK_ID" >&2
      exit 3
    fi
    TASK_FILES=("$task_file")
    [[ -z "$SUITE" ]] && SUITE="single"
    log "[LOAD] Loaded single task: $TASK_ID"
    return
  fi

  if [[ -n "$SKILL" ]]; then
    # Skill filter mode
    while IFS= read -r -d '' task_file; do
      local task_skill
      task_skill="$(yq -r '.skill // ""' "$task_file")"
      if [[ "$task_skill" == "$SKILL" ]]; then
        TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
      fi
    done < <(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' | tr '\n' '\0')
    [[ -z "$SUITE" ]] && SUITE="skill-$SKILL"
    log "[LOAD] Found ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks for skill: $SKILL"
    return
  fi

  if [[ -n "$SUITE" ]]; then
    local suite_file="$SUITES_DIR/${SUITE}.yaml"
    if [[ ! -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Suite not found: $suite_file" >&2
      exit 3
    fi

    # Read include patterns from suite
    local include_count
    include_count="$(yq -r '.tasks.include | length // 0' "$suite_file")"

    for i in $(seq 0 $((include_count - 1))); do
      local pattern
      pattern="$(yq -r ".tasks.include[$i]" "$suite_file")"

      # Resolve glob pattern relative to evals/
      # Use bash globbing with globstar for ** patterns
      local had_globstar=false
      shopt -q globstar 2>/dev/null && had_globstar=true
      shopt -s globstar 2>/dev/null || true

      local glob_expanded=false
      for task_file in $EVALS_DIR/$pattern; do
        if [[ -f "$task_file" ]]; then
          TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
          glob_expanded=true
        fi
      done

      # Restore globstar
      if [[ "$had_globstar" == "false" ]]; then
        shopt -u globstar 2>/dev/null || true
      fi

      # Fallback: if glob didn't match, try find in the directory
      if [[ "$glob_expanded" == "false" ]]; then
        # Extract directory portion from pattern
        local pattern_dir="${pattern%/*}"
        if [[ -d "$EVALS_DIR/$pattern_dir" ]]; then
          while IFS= read -r -d '' task_file; do
            TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
          done < <(find "$EVALS_DIR/$pattern_dir" \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) -type f -print0 2>/dev/null)
        fi
      fi
    done

    # Apply exclude patterns
    local exclude_count
    exclude_count="$(yq -r '.tasks.exclude | length // 0' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")"
    if [[ "$exclude_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
      local filtered_tasks=()
      for task_file in "${TASK_FILES[@]}"; do
        local excluded=false
        for j in $(seq 0 $((exclude_count - 1))); do
          local exclude_pattern
          exclude_pattern="$(yq -r ".tasks.exclude[$j]" "$suite_file")"
          if [[ "$(basename "$task_file")" == $exclude_pattern ]]; then
            excluded=true
            break
          fi
        done
        [[ "$excluded" == "false" ]] && filtered_tasks+=("$task_file")
      done
      TASK_FILES=("${filtered_tasks[@]}")
    fi

    # Read suite defaults
    SUITE_TRIALS="$(yq -r '.defaults.trials // 1' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_TIMEOUT_TRIAL="$(yq -r '.defaults.timeout.per_trial // 120' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_TIMEOUT_GRADER="$(yq -r '.defaults.timeout.per_grader // 30' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_STRATEGY="$(yq -r '.defaults.composite_strategy // "all_must_pass"' "$suite_file")"

    log "[LOAD] Suite '$SUITE': ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks, ${SUITE_TRIALS} trial(s)"
    return
  fi

  # Default: run all tasks
  while IFS= read -r -d '' task_file; do
    TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
  done < <(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' | sort | tr '\n' '\0')
  SUITE="all"
  log "[LOAD] Loaded ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks (all)"
}

# Suite defaults
SUITE_TRIALS=1
SUITE_TIMEOUT_TRIAL=120

name: review-recall
description: "cycle-124 FR-9 A/B suite: review-recall (arm A = Sprint-2 tip prompts, arm B = audited prompts; same executor model, fixed effort)"
version: 1

tasks:
  include:
    - "tasks/review-recall/**/*.yaml"
  exclude: []

defaults:
  trials: 3
  timeout:
    per_trial: 1500
    per_grader: 180
  composite_strategy: all_must_pass

# compare.sh freshness rule (evals/tests/recall-baseline-freshness.bats):
# a baseline must be captured at or after floor_commit (the Sprint-2 landing
# commit) on a prompt tree different from the one under comparison, with the
# corpus frozen.
ab:
  floor_commit: "da3bd07f3db2fc1bd09a6761a9b96b688fa2a09e"
  corpus_manifest: evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS

  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
  #                can never license removing the control
  arms:
    - id: baseline
      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
      toggles: {}
    - id: no_companion
      description: >-
        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile
        can remove; this arm measures its yield only.
      informational: true
      toggles:
        companion_voice: false
    - id: no_karpathy
      description: >-
        the '## Karpathy Principles' section removed from the sandbox
        CLAUDE.loa.md (and any Karpathy row from a sandbox constraints.json).
        It removes the kernel block only, not the SURGICAL review axis in
        reviewing-code/SKILL.md or the surgical-diff hook.
      toggles:
        karpathy_block: false
    - id: no_rule_files
      description: "stash-safety.md and skill-invariants.md removed from the sandbox .claude/rules/"
      toggles:
        rule_files: false

  # Pre-registered verdict rule (PRD FR-2; report.sh --arms applies it).
  # An arm reads `no recall loss` only when every condition holds; a violated
  # condition reads `recall loss`; anything missing reads `inconclusive`.
  threshold:
    # every (fixture, arm) cell needs this many completed trials
    trials_required: 3
    # full = every fixture in the batch for every arm; a missing cell is inconclusive
    coverage_required: full
    # the upper bound of the bootstrap interval on (baseline - arm) mean
    # recall must not exceed this (= ci.regression_threshold)
    mean_recall_max_drop: 0.10
    # the arm's worst trial-mean recall may sit at most this far below the baseline's worst
    min_trial_recall_max_drop: 0.15
    # refuted share (cited findings matching no feedback label and no fix
    # region, over cited findings) may rise at most this much over the baseline
    refuted_share_max_rise: 0.10
    # percentile bootstrap of the recall delta: resample fixtures with
    # replacement `iterations` times, report the `level` two-sided interval
    bootstrap:
      method: percentile
      level: 0.90
      resample: fixtures
      iterations: 2000

ci:
  gate_type: advisory
  min_trials: 3
  regression_threshold: 0.10

+cannot take effect; `executor.json` records `arm`, `arm_toggles`, `arm_evidence`, `source_commit`,

+live in the hidden `review-prs/labels/pr-NN.tsv` (never in the sandbox-copied `pr-NN/`), every drop is
+explained in `labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt`, and hand curation is the data file `labels/curation.tsv`,
+re-applied on every seed. `fix` rows (the hunks the fix commit changed) feed the grader's refuted share

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
     6	# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
     7	# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
     8	# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
     9	#
    10	# What it does, in order:
    11	#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
    12	#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
    13	#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
    14	#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
    15	#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
    16	#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
    17	#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
    18	#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
    19	#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
    20	#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
    21	#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
    22	#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
    23	#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
    24	#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
    25	#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
    26	#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
    27	#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
    28	#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
    29	#      records them defensively.
    30	#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
    31	#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
    32	#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
    33	#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
    34	#      `result` event) and executor.json:
    35	#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
    36	#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
    37	#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
    38	#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
    39	#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}
    40	#
    41	# Exit codes:
    42	#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)
    43	#   1  the CLI exited non-zero or timed out (executor.json still written)
    44	#   2  infrastructure error (CLI binary missing, prompt tree lacks the skill)
    45	#   3  task declares no agent (caller should not have called us)
    46	#
    47	# Env:
    48	#   EVAL_MODEL          model passed to --model            (default claude-sonnet-5)
    49	#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)
    50	#   EVAL_PROMPT_TREE    repo whose .claude/ is materialized (default: this repo)
    51	#   EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN     CLI executable                     (default: claude)
    52	#   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)
    53	#
    54	# Control arms (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.1):
    55	#   LOA_EVAL_ARM          arm id (default baseline). Setting it at all is "arm
    56	#                         mode": the prompt tree's .loa.config.yaml is also
    57	#                         materialised so every arm sees the same config.
    58	#   LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES  JSON object {toggle: false, …}; when unset the arm is
    59	#                         resolved from LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, else from
    60	#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)

    64	#   step and immediately before the executor starts; each is verified absent
    65	#   afterwards and a toggle that cannot take effect is exit 2 (an arm never
    66	#   silently runs as its baseline):
    67	#     companion_voice: false         flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
    68	#                                    in <ws>/.loa.config.yaml (yq)
    69	#     karpathy_block: false          '## Karpathy Principles' section out of
    70	#                                    <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md; Karpathy rows
    71	#                                    out of <ws>/.claude/data/constraints.json if present
    72	#     rule_files: false              stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of <ws>/.claude/rules/
    73	#     audit_delta_instruction: false the paragraph containing "look for what the
    74	#                                    review did not", else "Confirm the review's demotions
    75	#                                    independently", out of the sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md
    76	#   The appended skill prompt (.eval/skill-prompt.md) is derived from the
    77	#   toggled sandbox SKILL.md. executor.json records arm, arm_toggles,
    78	#   arm_evidence and source_commit.
    79	#
    80	# Tested by evals/tests/execute-agent.bats and evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats.
    81	# =============================================================================
    82	set -euo pipefail
    83	
    84	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    85	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    86	
    87	TASK_YAML=""
    88	WORKSPACE=""
    89	RUN_ID=""
    90	TRIAL_ID=""
    91	TIMEOUT_S=900
    92	
    93	usage() {
    94	  sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,60p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2
    95	  exit 2
    96	}
    97	
    98	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    99	  case "$1" in
   100	    --task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   101	    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   102	    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   103	    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   104	    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   105	    --help|-h) usage ;;
   106	    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
   107	  esac
   108	done
   109	
   110	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" && -n "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: --task-yaml and --workspace are required" >&2; exit 2; }
   111	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task YAML not found: $TASK_YAML" >&2; exit 2; }
   112	[[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: workspace not found: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 2; }
   113	WORKSPACE="$(cd "$WORKSPACE" && pwd)"
   114	
   115	# --- 1. gate ---------------------------------------------------------------
   116	skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
   117	if [[ -z "$skill" || "$skill" == "null" ]]; then
   118	  echo "execute-agent: task declares no .agent.skill — nothing to run" >&2
   119	  exit 3
   120	fi
   121	case "$skill" in
   122	  */*|.*|'') echo "ERROR: invalid skill name '$skill'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
   123	esac
   124	
   125	PROMPT_TREE="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$REPO_ROOT}"
   126	PROMPT_TREE="$(cd "$PROMPT_TREE" && pwd)"
   127	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   128	MODEL="${EVAL_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-5}"
   129	MAX_TURNS="${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}"
   130	
   131	skill_src="$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/skills/$skill"
   132	[[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { echo "ERROR: prompt tree $PROMPT_TREE has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" >&2; exit 2; }
   133	command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN (set EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN)" >&2; exit 2; }
   134	
   135	# --- 2. materialize ----------------------------------------------------------
   136	eval_dir="$WORKSPACE/.eval"
   137	mkdir -p "$eval_dir" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa"
   138	
   139	# Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
   140	skill_dst="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/$skill"
   141	mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
   142	cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
   143	if [[ -f "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
   144	  cp "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
   145	fi
   146	if [[ -d "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules" ]]; then
   147	  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules"
   148	  cp -a "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules/." "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/"
   149	fi
   150	printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$WORKSPACE/CLAUDE.md"
   285	  "$skill_dst/SKILL.md" > "$eval_dir/skill-prompt.md"
   286	
   287	# Prompt-tree identity (what the A/B is actually varying).
   288	prompt_tree_sha="$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" rev-parse HEAD:.claude 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   289	prompt_tree_commit="$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   290	prompt_tree_dirty=false
   291	if [[ -n "$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" status --porcelain -- .claude 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
   292	  prompt_tree_dirty=true
   293	fi
   294	
   295	# Effort: env > task > skill frontmatter > none; invalid → none.
   296	resolve_effort() {
   297	  local cand="${EVAL_EFFORT:-}"
   298	  if [[ -z "$cand" ]]; then
   299	    cand="$(yq -r '.agent.effort // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
   300	  fi
   301	  if [[ -z "$cand" || "$cand" == "null" ]]; then
   302	    cand="$(awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---"{exit} NR>1 && $0=="---"{exit} NR>1{print}' "$skill_src/SKILL.md" \
   303	      | yq -r '.effort // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)"
   304	  fi
   305	  case "$cand" in
   306	    low|medium|high|xhigh|max) printf '%s' "$cand" ;;
   307	    *) printf '' ;;
   308	  esac
   309	}
   310	effort="$(resolve_effort)"
   311	
   312	prompt="$(yq -r '.prompt // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
   313	[[ -n "$prompt" && "$prompt" != "null" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task has no prompt" >&2; exit 2; }
   314	
   315	# --- 3. run ------------------------------------------------------------------
   316	argv=(
   317	  "$CLAUDE_BIN" -p "$prompt"
   318	  --output-format stream-json --verbose
   319	  --model "$MODEL"
   320	  --restricted --tools "Read,Grep,Glob,Write"
   321	  --permission-mode acceptEdits
   322	  --append-system-prompt-file "$eval_dir/skill-prompt.md"
   323	  --max-turns "$MAX_TURNS"
   324	)
   325	[[ -n "$effort" ]] && argv+=(--effort "$effort")
   326	
   327	events="$eval_dir/events.jsonl"
   328	stderr_log="$eval_dir/agent-stderr.log"
   329	start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   330	rc=0
   331	(
   332	  cd "$WORKSPACE" || exit 2
   333	  export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$eval_dir/model-invoke.jsonl"
   334	  export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$eval_dir/cost-ledger.jsonl"
   335	  export EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL"
   336	  # sprint-237 audit HIGH-001: the CLI keeps HOME (its own credentials live there)
   337	  # and PATH (its toolchain); the operator's other credentials are not the agent
   338	  # under test's business, and its temp files stay inside the sandbox.
   339	  unset GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
   340	  # cycle-129: an executor started from inside a Claude Code session inherits
   341	  # that session's coupling (child-session flag, session id, messaging socket,
   342	  # agent teams) and its subagent model (the sprint-255 driver session carried
   343	  # CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=opus). Decouple the session and pin every
   344	  # auxiliary model to the executor model. (A safeguard-refusal fallback to
   345	  # another model is a separate CLI behaviour, recorded below as
   346	  # refusal_fallbacks; no environment setting turns it off.)
   347	  unset CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET \
   348	    CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED
   349	  export CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL="$MODEL"
   350	  mkdir -p "$eval_dir/tmp" && export TMPDIR="$eval_dir/tmp"
   351	  exec timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$TIMEOUT_S" "${argv[@]}"
   352	) > "$events" 2> "$stderr_log" || rc=$?
   353	end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   354	duration_ms=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))
   355	
   356	# --- 4. record ---------------------------------------------------------------
   357	# The last `result` event is the CLI's summary (absent on crash/timeout).
   358	result_json="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
   359	if [[ -z "$result_json" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result_json"; then
   360	  result_json='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
   361	fi
   362	printf '%s\n' "$result_json" > "$eval_dir/agent-output.json"
   363	
   364	# Ordered tool writes from the transcript (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit).
   365	tool_writes="$(jq -c '
   366	  select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? |
   367	  select(.type=="tool_use" and (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit" or .name=="MultiEdit" or .name=="NotebookEdit")) |
   368	  {tool:.name, path:(.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
   369	' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc 'to_entries | map({seq:(.key+1), tool:.value.tool, path:.value.path})' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
   370	[[ -n "$tool_writes" ]] || tool_writes='[]'
   371	
   372	# cycle-129: a safeguard refusal makes the CLI retry the session on another
   373	# model (system/model_refusal_fallback); the arm run must see it, because the
   374	# output after it is not the requested executor's.
   375	refusal_fallbacks="$(jq -c 'select(.type=="system" and .subtype=="model_refusal_fallback")
   376	  | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null),
   377	     scope: (.scope // null)}' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
   378	[[ -n "$refusal_fallbacks" ]] || refusal_fallbacks='[]'
   379	
   380	is_error="$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$result_json")"
   381	[[ $rc -ne 0 ]] && is_error=true
   382	
   383	jq -n \
   384	  --arg skill "$skill" \
   385	  --arg model_requested "$MODEL" \
   386	  --arg effort "$effort" \
   387	  --arg prompt_tree "$PROMPT_TREE" \
   388	  --arg prompt_tree_sha "$prompt_tree_sha" \
   389	  --arg prompt_tree_commit "$prompt_tree_commit" \
   390	  --argjson prompt_tree_dirty "$prompt_tree_dirty" \
   391	  --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
   392	  --arg trial_id "$TRIAL_ID" \
   393	  --argjson rc "$rc" \
   394	  --argjson is_error "$is_error" \
   395	  --argjson duration_ms "$duration_ms" \
   396	  --argjson result "$result_json" \
   397	  --argjson tool_writes "$tool_writes" \
   398	  --arg arm "$ARM" \
   399	  --argjson arm_toggles "$ARM_TOGGLES" \
   400	  --argjson arm_evidence "$ARM_EVIDENCE" \
   401	  --arg source_commit "${LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT:-$prompt_tree_commit}" \
   402	  --argjson refusal_fallbacks "$refusal_fallbacks" \
   403	  '
   404	  def norm_usage(u): {
   405	    input_tokens: (u.input_tokens // u.inputTokens // 0),
   406	    output_tokens: (u.output_tokens // u.outputTokens // 0),
   407	    cache_creation_input_tokens: (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // u.cacheCreationInputTokens // 0),
   408	    cache_read_input_tokens: (u.cache_read_input_tokens // u.cacheReadInputTokens // 0)
   409	  };
   410	  ($result.modelUsage // {}) as $mu |
   411	  # the model that produced the output: the modelUsage entry with the most
   412	  # output tokens (a haiku helper call must not be mis-attributed — the
   413	  # framework-review 2026-09-17 rec 5 class), else the requested id.
   414	  (if ($mu | length) > 0
   415	     then ($mu | to_entries | max_by(.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0) | .key)
   416	     else $model_requested end) as $model_id |
   417	  {
   418	    schema_version: 1,
   419	    skill: $skill,
   420	    run_id: $run_id,
   421	    trial_id: $trial_id,
   422	    model_requested: $model_requested,
   423	    model_id: $model_id,
   424	    effort: $effort,
   425	    prompt_tree: $prompt_tree,
   426	    prompt_tree_sha: $prompt_tree_sha,
   427	    prompt_tree_commit: $prompt_tree_commit,
   428	    prompt_tree_dirty: $prompt_tree_dirty,
   429	    exit_code: $rc,
   430	    is_error: $is_error,
   431	    duration_ms: $duration_ms,
   432	    num_turns: ($result.num_turns // 0),
   433	    total_cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // 0),
   434	    usage: norm_usage($result.usage // {}),
   435	    models_used: ($mu | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
   436	    refusal_fallbacks: $refusal_fallbacks,
   437	    tool_writes: $tool_writes,
   438	    arm: $arm,
   439	    arm_toggles: $arm_toggles,
   440	    arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
   441	    source_commit: $source_commit
   442	  }' > "$eval_dir/executor.json"
   443	
   444	if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
   445	  echo "execute-agent: CLI exited $rc (see $stderr_log)" >&2
   446	  exit 1
   447	fi
   448	exit 0

content.content:
name: Prompt Budget

# cycle-124 FR-8 (AC-8.1): the always-loaded prompt surface has hard byte
# budgets — SKILL.md ≤ 16,384 B (charged with unconditionally-read resources),
# CLAUDE.loa.md ≤ 10,240 B, protocols total ≤ 160,000 B (warn > 114,688 B).
# tools/check-prompt-budget.sh is the gate; the two sentinel steps prove the
# gate itself still bites (a scanner that exits 0 from a syntax error must not
# read as green).

on:
  # Every pull request: the gate takes seconds, and a path filter would miss the
  # shared inputs the checker charges (skill includes rendered into SKILL.md,
  # resources read unconditionally, the keep list) — Bridgebuilder F-001 on
  # PR #1266.
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  prompt-budget:
    name: Byte budgets for the prompt surface
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        # actions/checkout@v4.3.1 (pinned per cycle-098 supply-chain pattern)
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5

      - name: Check budgets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rc=0
          bash tools/check-prompt-budget.sh --json > prompt-budget.json || rc=$?
          # A checker that dies before writing a report must fail LOUD with its
          # exit code, not as an opaque jq parse error (Bridgebuilder F-003).
          if ! jq -e . prompt-budget.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::check-prompt-budget.sh --json produced no parseable report (exit $rc)"
            cat prompt-budget.json || true
            exit 1
          fi
          # Human-readable table for the log; the JSON gate below is the verdict.
          bash tools/check-prompt-budget.sh || echo "::notice::human-readable run exited non-zero; the JSON gate decides"
          jq -r '.violations[]? | "::error::prompt budget: \(.)"' prompt-budget.json
          jq -e '.ok' prompt-budget.json >/dev/null

      - name: Positive control (the gate rejects the over-budget sentinel with exit 1)
        if: success()   # controls prove the gate bites; a real budget failure above stays the visible failure (Bridgebuilder iter-5 F-003)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rc=0
          bash tools/check-prompt-budget.sh --root tests/fixtures/prompt-budget/over --quiet || rc=$?
          if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::check-prompt-budget.sh did not reject tests/fixtures/prompt-budget/over with exit 1 (got $rc)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: over-budget sentinel rejected"

      - name: Negative control (the gate accepts the under-budget sentinel)
        if: success()   # controls prove the gate bites; a real budget failure above stays the visible failure (Bridgebuilder iter-5 F-003)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! bash tools/check-prompt-budget.sh --root tests/fixtures/prompt-budget/under --quiet; then
            echo "::error::check-prompt-budget.sh false-positive on tests/fixtures/prompt-budget/under"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: under-budget sentinel accepted"

      - name: Upload report
        if: success()   # controls prove the gate bites; a real budget failure above stays the visible failure (Bridgebuilder iter-5 F-003)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: prompt-budget-report
          path: prompt-budget.json
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Install bats-core v1.13.0

  corpus_manifest: evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS

  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
  #                can never license removing the control
  arms:
    - id: baseline
      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
      toggles: {}
    - id: no_companion
      description: >-
        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile
        can remove; this arm measures its yield only.
      informational: true
      toggles:
        companion_voice: false
    - id: no_karpathy
      description: >-
        the '## Karpathy Principles' section removed from the sandbox
        CLAUDE.loa.md (and any Karpathy row from a sandbox constraints.json).
        It removes the kernel block only, not the SURGICAL review axis in
        reviewing-code/SKILL.md or the surgical-diff hook.
      toggles:
        karpathy_block: false
    - id: no_rule_files
      description: "stash-safety.md and skill-invariants.md removed from the sandbox .claude/rules/"
      toggles:
        rule_files: false

  # Pre-registered verdict rule (PRD FR-2; report.sh --arms applies it).
  # An arm reads `no recall loss` only when every condition holds; a violated
  # condition reads `recall loss`; anything missing reads `inconclusive`.
  threshold:
    # every (fixture, arm) cell needs this many completed trials
    trials_required: 3
    # full = every fixture in the batch for every arm; a missing cell is inconclusive
    coverage_required: full
    # the upper bound of the bootstrap interval on (baseline - arm) mean
    # recall must not exceed this (= ci.regression_threshold)
    mean_recall_max_drop: 0.10
    # the arm's worst trial-mean recall may sit at most this far below the baseline's worst
    min_trial_recall_max_drop: 0.15
    # refuted share (cited findings matching no feedback label and no fix
    # region, over cited findings) may rise at most this much over the baseline
    refuted_share_max_rise: 0.10
    # percentile bootstrap of the recall delta: resample fixtures with
    # replacement `iterations` times, report the `level` two-sided interval
    bootstrap:
      method: percentile
      level: 0.90
      resample: fixtures
      iterations: 2000

  min_trials: 3
  regression_threshold: 0.10

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/loa-status-guards.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD AC-1.5, SDD D-1.5)
     5	# `/loa` prints one Guards line: register counts from grimoires/loa/guards.md and
     6	# the 30-day host yield from .run/guard-yield.json (never recomputed at status
     7	# time), or the regenerate hint when the yield file is missing. Fixture files via
     8	# the bats-gated LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE / LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE seams.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  umask 022
    13	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
    14	  PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    15	  STATUS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh"
    16	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/lsg.XXXXXX")"
    17	  mkdir -p "$T/run" "$T/env"
    18	  export LOA_STATUS_RUN_DIR="$T/run" LOA_STATUS_ENV_DIR="$T/env" LOA_STATUS_CONFIG_FILE="$T/no-loa-config.yaml"
    19	  printf '# Guard register\n\n- guards: 94\n- guards_without_origin: 0\n- dormant: 3\n- floor: 21\n' > "$T/guards.md"
    20	  jq -n '{schema_version: 1, generated_at: "2026-10-14", window_days: 30, scope: "host",
    21	          totals: {guards: 94, real_blocks_30d: 87, likely_fp_30d: 72}}' > "$T/guard-yield.json"
    22	  export LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE="$T/guards.md" LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE="$T/guard-yield.json"
    23	}
    24	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    25	
    26	@test "LSG-1 the Guards line carries the register counts and the host yield from the yield file" {
    27	  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check
    28	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    29	  line="$(grep -E '^Guards: ' <<<"$output" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')"
    30	  [ "$line" = "Guards: 94 (0 without origin, 3 dormant) · 30 d: 87 real blocks, 72 likely FP · scope host · regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh" ]

    32	
    33	@test "LSG-2 with no yield file the line keeps the structural counts and prints the regenerate hint" {
    34	  rm -f "$T/guard-yield.json"

    38	  [ "$line" = "Guards: 94 (0 without origin, 3 dormant) · 30 d: no yield file (.run/guard-yield.json) · regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh" ]
    39	}

    43	  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check

    45	  grep -qE '^.*Guards: .*94 \(0 without origin, 3 dormant\) · 30 d: no yield file' <<<"$output"

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158

recall-vs-defects.sh
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# recall-vs-defects.sh — deterministic planted-defect recall grader
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9). Args: $1=workspace, $2=fixture id (pr-NN),
     6	# $3=review file (default review.md). Reads the HIDDEN manifest
     7	# evals/fixtures/review-prs/manifests/<id>.json (never copied into the
     8	# sandbox) and the agent's review.
     9	#
    10	# Rule (PRD FR-9 A/B protocol, no fuzzy adjudication): a defect is DETECTED
    11	# when the review contains a `path:line` (or `path:line-line`) citation whose
    12	# path ends with the defect's file (repo-relative, `head/`-prefixed, or the
    13	# bare basename) and whose line, or line range, falls within ±3 of the
    14	# manifest anchor — `anchor_line`, or any line in `anchors[]` for a defect
    15	# with more than one site.
    16	#
    17	# Parser (1.1.0, bd-ewrc): a leading `(` is not part of the path; comma
    18	# continuations (`path:776,807`, `path:10, 118-121`) and a later bare `:N` or
    19	# `head:N` / `base:N` bind to the most recent cited path. A `:N` glued to a
    20	# word or a number (`note:40`, `10:40`), or with no cited path before it,
    21	# credits nothing.
    22	#
    23	# Parser 1.1.1 (sprint-250 review run 1, n40-n42): the LOA-VERDICT trailer is
    24	# removed before citations are parsed, and a bare `:N` after a quote, bracket,
    25	# brace or `*` (JSON such as `"high":3`) credits nothing; a backtick- or
    26	# bold-wrapped path (`` `b.sh`:40 ``, `**b.sh**:40`) binds its own line; a comma
    27	# continuation or range stays on its line, and a continuation must end at a
    28	# number boundary (no dates);
    29	# a path containing `//` (a URL) is not a citation.
    30	# Run 2 (#11/#13-#15): a match inside any URL token (`scheme://...`) is not a
    31	# citation; a range dash is unspaced and every number (first, continuation,
    32	# bare) ends at a boundary (no further `-N` / `–N`: no dates); the
    33	# quote/bracket guard applies only to the fully bare `:N` (plus a closing
    34	# backtick), so `"head:40"` binds as in 1.1.0; one trailer pattern strips and
    35	# reads the LOA-VERDICT comment and never crosses another comment's bounds.
    36	# Parser 1.1.2 (the run 2 changes above, plus sprint-250 review run 3): the
    37	# URL look-back takes the text after the last whitespace — one linear split —
    38	# so a citation that opens a line never inherits the previous line's URL.
    39	# The parser runs as `python3 -I -` (audit dissent run 1, n32): a module planted
    40	# in the invoker's cwd (a forging json.py) is never imported (RG-27).
    41	#
    42	# Grader 1.2.0 (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.3): adds the refuted-share figure;
    43	# the recall rule and the pass/score contract are unchanged. A FINDING is one
    44	# distinct cited (path, line-range); it is MATCHED when it overlaps (±3) a
    45	# defect site or a manifest `fix_regions[]` entry ({file, start, end}: the
    46	# head-side lines a record fixture's fix commit touched). details gain
    47	# findings_cited, findings_refuted and refuted_share (refuted / cited; null
    48	# when nothing is cited).
    49	#
    50	# Clean fixtures (0 planted defects) measure FALSE POSITIVES: the LOA-VERDICT
    51	# trailer's critical+high counts; without a trailer, every file:line citation
    52	# counts as one.
    53	#
    54	# Output: {"pass", "score", "details":{recall, planted, detected[], missed[],
    55	#          false_positives, severity_counts, model, effort, tokens}, "grader_version"}
    56	#   pass  = every planted defect detected (defect fixture) / zero false
    57	#           positives (clean fixture); score = recall*100 or 100/0.
    58	# Exit: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 error (missing manifest / bad args)
    59	#
    60	# Tested by evals/tests/eval-recall-grader.bats.
    61	# =============================================================================
    62	set -euo pipefail
    63	
    64	workspace="${1:-}"
    65	fixture="${2:-}"
    66	review_name="${3:-review.md}"
    67	
    68	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    69	MANIFEST_DIR="${EVAL_MANIFEST_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/../fixtures/review-prs/manifests}"
    70

     8	# likely-false-positive heuristic (heredoc, outside-repo cwd, prose class without
     9	# a destructive verb at statement start), day-granular last_real_catch, the
    10	# --check drift gate (0 after generation, 1 after an origin edit, 0 after a
    11	# yield-only change), the --json shape, and no command text or cwd in any output.

    14	NOW="2026-10-14T12:00:00Z"

    16	setup() {
    17	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1

**Version:** 1.3

## Executive Summary

Three sprints deliver the eight functional requirements of the cycle-128 PRD without changing verdict derivation, gate ordering or the dissent artefact gate (the review skill gains two checklist rows and one citation line; nothing it gates changes). Sprint 1 lands the small, high-leverage changes and the decision ledger the later sprints write to. Sprint 2 builds the decision map (`/chart`) and the prototype-ticket discipline on top of the ledger. Sprint 3 adds the glossary, the seams-under-test and red-before-green checks, the documentation, and the end-to-end validation of every PRD goal. The lead's main checkout is the only writer of `grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml`; implementers and tests write fixtures only (`--file`). 1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# claude-stub.sh — stand-in for the `claude` CLI used by evals/tests/*.bats.
     3	# Records argv + selected env, optionally writes files into the cwd, and
     4	# emits a canned stream-json transcript so execute-agent.sh can be tested
     5	# without a model call.
     6	#
     7	#   STUB_ARGV_FILE   where "$@" is written (one arg per line)
     8	#   STUB_ENV_FILE    where selected env vars are written (KEY=VALUE)
     9	#   STUB_EVENTS_FILE stream-json lines to emit (default: a 2-write transcript)
    10	#   STUB_WRITE_<n>   "relative/path::content" files to create in the cwd
    11	#   STUB_EXIT        exit code (default 0)
    12	#   STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR  copy the cwd's CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .loa.config.yaml and
    13	#                    the --append-system-prompt-file there at start: the
    14	#                    sandbox exactly as the executor sees it (arm-toggles.bats)
    15	#   STUB_FAIL_COUNTER  a file holding N: while N > 0, decrement it and exit 1
    16	#                    with no result event (a transport failure; run-arms.bats)
    17	set -euo pipefail
    18	
    19	# `--version` (run-arms.sh records it in MANIFEST.json) has no side effects
    20	if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "0.0.0 (claude-stub)"; exit 0; fi
    21	
    22	if [[ -n "${STUB_FAIL_COUNTER:-}" && -f "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER" ]]; then
    23	  n="$(cat "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER")"
    24	  if [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]]; then
    25	    echo $((n - 1)) > "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER"
    26	    echo "stub: simulated transport failure (socket hang up)" >&2
    27	    exit 1
    28	  fi
    29	fi
    30	
    31	if [[ -n "${STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    32	  mkdir -p "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR"
    33	  for p in CLAUDE.md .claude .loa.config.yaml; do
    34	    [[ -e "$p" ]] && cp -a "$p" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/"
    35	  done
    36	  prev=""
    37	  for a in "$@"; do
    38	    [[ "$prev" == "--append-system-prompt-file" ]] && cp "$a" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/system-prompt.md"
    39	    prev="$a"
    40	  done
    41	fi
    42	
    43	if [[ -n "${STUB_ARGV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    44	  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_ARGV_FILE"
    45	fi
    46	if [[ -n "${STUB_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    47	  {
    48	    printf 'PWD=%s\n' "$PWD"
    49	    for k in LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH HOME EVAL_MODEL TMPDIR GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY \
    50	             CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS; do
    51	      printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "${!k:-}"
    52	    done
    53	  } > "$STUB_ENV_FILE"
    54	fi
    55	
    56	for var in "${!STUB_WRITE_@}"; do
    57	  spec="${!var}"
    58	  rel="${spec%%::*}"
    59	  body="${spec#*::}"
    60	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$rel")"
    61	  printf '%b' "$body" > "$rel"
    62	done

    64	if [[ -n "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE:-}" && -f "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE}" ]]; then
    65	  cat "$STUB_EVENTS_FILE"
    66	else
    67	  cat <<'EVENTS'
    68	{"type":"system","subtype":"init","model":"claude-sonnet-5"}
    69	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"tests/test_x.py","content":"def test_x(): assert False"}}]}}
    70	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"src/x.py","content":"X = 1"}}]}}

    72	EVENTS
    73	fi

import sys,json
hooks={}
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.strip().strip("|")
    # split on unescaped |
    import re
    cells=[c.strip().replace("\\|","|") for c in re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|",line)]
    ev,mt,sc=cells[0],cells[1],cells[2].strip("`")
    mt="" if mt=="(all)" else mt
    pfx="\"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)\"/.claude/"
    if sc.startswith("hook-guard.sh "):
        p=sc[len("hook-guard.sh "):]
        cmd=pfx+"hooks/hook-guard.sh "+pfx+("hooks/"+p if not p.startswith("scripts/") else p)
    else:
        cmd=pfx+("hooks/"+sc if not sc.startswith("scripts/") else sc)
    lst=hooks.setdefault(ev,[])
    ent=next((e for e in lst if e.get("matcher","")==mt),None)
    if not ent:
        ent={"matcher":mt,"hooks":[]} if mt else {"hooks":[]}
        lst.append(ent)
    ent["hooks"].append({"type":"command","command":cmd})
print(json.dumps({"hooks":hooks},indent=1))
' > .claude/settings.json; jq '.hooks|keys' .claude/settings.json; jq -r '..|.command?//empty' .claude/settings.json | sed 's/.*\.claude\///' | sort -u | while read p; do mkdir -p .claude/$(dirname $p); [ -f .claude/$p ] || echo '#!/bin/bash' > .claude/$p; done; for s in .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh .claude/hooks/safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh .claude/hooks/compliance/implement-gate.sh .claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh tools/check-prompt-budget.sh .claude/hooks/settings.deny.json .claude/data/user-invoked-commands.txt; do mkdir -p $(dirname $s); [ -f $s ] || touch $s; done; git init -q . 2>/dev/null; bash .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --now 2026-10-14 --yield-dir /tmp/review-scratch2/yd --out /tmp/review-scratch2/guards.md; echo rc=$?

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/execute-agent.bats — cycle-124 Sprint 3 Task 3.2 (FR-9 / SDD §3.6)
#
# evals/harness/execute-agent.sh is the agent-execution step at the
# run-eval.sh:379 slot. It is gated on a task's `.agent.skill`; it
# materializes the prompt surface (skill body without frontmatter, CLAUDE.md
# → CLAUDE.loa.md, rules) from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox, runs the
# headless CLI with a fixed tool set, and records executor.json (model id the
# CLI echoed, usage, prompt_tree_sha, ordered tool writes). The CLI is
# replaced by evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub.sh here.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  EXEC="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh"
  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ea.XXXXXX")"
  WS="$T/ws"
  mkdir -p "$WS"
  ( cd "$WS" && git init -q && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init )
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$STUB"
  export EVAL_MODEL="claude-sonnet-5"
  export EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$REPO_ROOT"
  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
  export STUB_ENV_FILE="$T/env"
  unset EVAL_EFFORT
  # A task that declares an agent (the executor's gate).
  cat > "$T/task.yaml" <<'YAML'
id: ea-task
schema_version: 1
skill: reviewing-code
category: skill-quality
fixture: hello-world-ts
description: "executor test task"
prompt: "Read REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md and carry it out."
agent:
  skill: reviewing-code
  artifacts: [review.md]
graders:
  - type: code
    script: file-exists.sh
    args: ["review.md"]
YAML
  # The same task without an agent block.
  grep -v -E '^(agent:|  skill: reviewing-code$|  artifacts:)' "$T/task.yaml" > "$T/task-noagent.yaml"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Build a throwaway prompt tree with one skill carrying the given frontmatter.
make_tree() {  # make_tree <dir> <effort-line-or-empty>
  local d="$1" eff="$2"
  local sk="$d/.claude/skills/fake-skill"
  mkdir -p "$sk" "$d/.claude/loa" "$d/.claude/rules"
  {
    echo "---"
    echo "name: fake"
    [[ -n "$eff" ]] && echo "$eff"
    echo "---"
    echo "# Fake skill body"
    echo "Do fake things."
  } > "$sk/SKILL.md"
  echo "# loa" > "$d/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  echo "rule" > "$d/.claude/rules/r.md"
  ( cd "$d" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m tree )
}
